composeDescription: What do you want to talk about?
rantDescription: Let it all out! We'll help you turn it into a structured discussion.
reviewDescription: Look good? Edit anything that needs tweaking.
addDetailsDescription: Add any additional details to your post.
shareDescription: Spread the word about your new post!
preferRant: Prefer to start with a free-form rant instead?
helpDialogDescription: Your topic describes what the conversation is about. Your seed statements are what people will vote on (agree/disagree/pass). People can also add their own statements to be voted on.
helpExampleTopic: Should our city invest more in public transportation?
helpExampleStatement1: Public transportation reduces traffic congestion and improves air quality
helpExampleStatement2: The cost of expanding public transit is too high for our city's budget
helpExampleStatement3: Investing in bike lanes would be more cost-effective than buses or trains
helpClusterNote: 💡 People will see the topic at the top, then vote agree/disagree/pass on each statement. The system clusters people by how they vote to find common ground.
rantPlaceholder: Let it all out... tell us what you really think! 🔥
rantPrivateNote: Your rant is private — it's just used to draft the post topic and won't be visible to other users.
